text:
Jay (Partnerships): FYI we got verbal greenlight from AuroraCloud to list Redwood in their new "south-region" marketplace next month — they want a coordinated go-live plan.
Ana (Partnerships): Nice! timeline? do we have quota numbers from Aurora? :eyes:
Jay (Partnerships): Aurora says initial quota = 8 dedicated GPU instances + burst up to 24 for first 4 weeks. Need KMS integration, marketplace SKU mapping, and SI test window.
Leo (Ops): tagging @Marcus — can we support 8 reserved GPUs in that region with current nodepools?
Marcus (SRE): short answer: yes for 8, but autoscaler bump + image prewarming needed. estimate: 3-5 days to provision infra, 1 day for warm-up.
Ana (Partnerships): Aurora also requires an entitlement SKU and a marketplace billing link. I have the draft SKU names from their portal.
Jay (Partnerships): dropping the SKU snippet they asked for:
```
SKU: redwood-inference.south.v1
Capacity: reserved-8
Burst: burst-24
KMS: customer-managed
```
Marcus (SRE): for KMS we need terraform changes and KMS key policy from Aurora side. Sophie, any compliance nails for customer-managed keys? @Sophie
Sophie (Legal): yes — need joint data processing addendum and KMS key usage SLA in place. I can draft the DPA + KMS appendix; will need Aurora legal contact.
Leo (Ops): operational checklist: 1) provision nodepool 2) update load-balancer region routing 3) marketplace entitlement mapping 4) alerting/SLI targets 5) smoke tests + SI runbook. I can own 1-2 and 4.
Ana (Partnerships): I'll own marketplace mapping + partner comms. Jay can you confirm launch announcement cadence with Aurora marketing?
Jay (Partnerships): pinged Aurora PM (Lina) — she suggested a soft-launch + joint blog 2 weeks after soft launch. Lina requested a canary window of 48h.
Marcus (SRE): propose SI (system integrator) test window: Tue-Thu next week, 09:00-13:00 PT. Need Aurora to run entitlements against staging SKU first.
Ana (Partnerships): noted. I will put staging SKU into the test ticket.
CloudBot: ticket #PRT-2148 created: "Aurora South - marketplace onramp" assigned to Ana, Marcus, Leo. ETA: provis: 3-5 days.
Sophie (Legal): I'll start DPA draft tonight, target review by EOD+2.
Jay (Partnerships): Ok next steps: Ana to confirm Aurora legal contact & staging SKU, Marcus to open infra PR, Leo to add alerting, Sophie DPA draft. We'll sync Friday 10:30am PT. Any blockers?
Marcus (SRE): one potential: GPU SKU availability on provider may change; will request capacity hold from Aurora ops.
Ana (Partnerships): I'll ask Aurora ops for a 7-day capacity hold and confirm back here.
Leo (Ops): if hold is approved, we can hit the canary window. otherwise we delay announcement.
Jay (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll send calendar invite for Friday sync and loop in Aurora PM. :thumbsup:
